errors.text_span: This pie chart represents the win rates of four distinct large language models – GPT-4o, GPT-4o, Mistral, and LLaMA – across a series of evaluations of empathetic responses as judged by Gemini. The chart consists of five slices, each representing a different model
errors.evidence: The figure is a nested donut chart showing two separate comparisons in two concentric rings, not a single pie chart. There are a total of four segments (two per ring), not five slices.

errors.text_span: visually ordered from largest to smallest
errors.evidence: The segments are not ordered by size. For instance, in the outer ring, the largest slice (Mistral, 88.0%) is adjacent to the smallest slice (GPT-4o, 12.0%).

errors.text_span: The largest slice, colored blue, represents GPT-4o with a win rate of approximately 19.6%
errors.evidence: This is incorrect. The largest slice represents Mistral with 88.0% and is light blue. The GPT-4o slice with 19.6% is dark red and is one of the smaller segments.

errors.text_span: A red slice labeled Mistral occupies roughly 88.0% of the remaining area
errors.evidence: The red slice corresponds to GPT-4o with a value of 19.6%. The Mistral slice is light blue with a value of 88.0%.

errors.text_span: two gray slices represent LLaMA and GPT-4o, each with approximately 80.4% of the remaining space, respectively.
errors.evidence: The chart does not contain any gray slices. The LLaMA slice is light beige/off-white. Furthermore, there is no GPT-4o slice with a value of 80.4%.

errors.text_span: The chart includes percentage labels displayed directly within each slice
errors.evidence: The percentage labels are positioned outside the chart and are connected to their corresponding segments by lines.
